description: List the errors a product's backend sent to featury, grouped: the same error from many people is one group. Each group has its type, a message template with the details taken out, the feature it hit, how many people and events, when it was first and last seen, the likely change behind it and the request it's linked to. Groups that came back after a fix come first. Status defaults to OPEN. Pages of 50: pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. ENGINEER and above.

feature.description: A feature id from list_features, or a feature key such as "search"

noise.description: True to also list the groups featury set aside as noise (hidden by default)

period.description: Days to count people and events over: 7 (default), 30 or 90

side.description: SERVER for the backend's errors, CLIENT for the browser's

name: list_error_groups
title: List error groups
